summary: User requested redesign of the platform backbone around PRD Builder, Planning Wizard, durable planning, execution handoff, and hallucination/drift prevention.
Latest repository, Planning docs, GUI concept, ledger system, Plan layout, Goal Runtime, audit, source-control, testing, Plan Compile, WorkNode, and Orchestrator changes were reviewed.
Requirements Doc Builder became PRD Builder; Chain Wizard and Plan Wizard became Planning Wizard.
PRD Builder creates a planning-intake PRD Pack; Planning Wizard resolves implementation-ready plans.
Conversation-first, import-first, and hybrid PRD Builder modes plus large-document normalization and live annotations were accepted.
Write-after-turn became a hard rule for both PRD Builder and Planning Wizard.
Existing Assistant Chat is reused with a collapsible Planning Run parent and bounded topic/integration/audit child threads.
Collaborator workflow profiles plus Overseer, Auditor, and High-Effort Worker roles were accepted.
Dynamic topic map, fresh topic agents, per-topic compile/audit, Context Capsules, invalidation, and final integration were accepted.
Greenfield, existing local/Git, remote SSH, fork/upstream, feature/refactor/bugfix/PR contexts and source-control authority rules were accepted.
Automated testing default, explicit scoped overrides, online capability research, safe installation, and visible testing were accepted.
Global and per-project Auto/On/Off settings for individual testing capabilities were accepted.
Final action was set exactly to Approve And Build with immediate Orchestrator Plan Compile navigation.
Immutable approval, PlanApproved, PlanCompile stages, Executor intake, WorkNode materialization, and atomic GoalRun start were converged.
Product-native parallel audit/repair, closure-aware findings, minimal HITL, and zero unapproved incomplete content were accepted.
Existing compact-state resume/compile/index/seal/audit/repair flow was retained and hardened for parallel evidence and this ledger.
All discussed decisions were atomized with no open product questions or blockers and prepared for canonical Plans compilation.

Ledger was resumed in conversational Collaborator mode after the compile-ready cursor; no canonical Plans, generated governance artifacts, WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, GoalRuns, implementation files, or new design atoms were created.

Explicit Goal authorization started ledger-to-Plans compilation for 168 ready atoms. This event does not create WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, GoalRuns, implementation files, generated governance artifacts, or production build tasks.

Compiled 168 accepted atoms into 61 live PlanUnits across canonical Plans owner docs, regenerated allowed Plans/.plan_index outputs, and left governance seal artifacts pending for a separate explicit seal phase.

Post-compile validation recorded: bootstrap ledger validator, PlanUnit index validation, and git diff whitespace checks pass; migration, run-gates, and shard checks are stale because governance seal artifacts were intentionally not refreshed in this compile phase.

Governance seal refreshed migration proof, configured shards, evidence hashes, Spec Lock, and required validators after PRD Builder / Planning Wizard Plans and PlanUnit index stabilized. No WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, final node manifests, GoalRuns, implementation files, or production build tasks were created.
